title: Symbols of Elements
notes:
Element Symbols

Short representations of element names. Rules: Capital 1st letter, 2-letter combos (He, Mg), or Latin names (Na: Natrium, K: Kalium, Fe: Ferrum, Cu: Cuprum, Ag: Argentum, Au: Aurum, Pb: Plumbum, Sn: Stannum, Hg: Hydrargyrum, Sb: Stibium).
summary: Derivation rules and Latin roots for chemical symbols.
